name: Crush the Uninvited AP OLD

stealth.note: (legendary); @Check[perception|dc:20] to notice the warning carved in the door frame

description: A warning carved into the door frame magically crushes any who pass through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission.
disable: DC 48 Thievery (legendary) to scratch out the warning or Dispel Magic (10th rank; counteract DC 48) to counteract the magic in the warning

generalAbilities.name: Implosion
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature passes through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission

Effect The trap casts implosion on the triggering creature. This is a 10th-rank Implosion spell that deals 85 Untyped Damage damage (Basic DC 47 Fortitude Saving Throw).
